author: claude
summary: Task 007 of the voice-variant tagging + IA plan: wires performance_tags editing into the CURRENT stacked-card VariantEditor (pre-task-008/009 layout), per the adversarial review's de-risk recommendation. VariantEditor now renders TagAutocompleteInput in its header, saving via the existing per-variant settings-write endpoint. VariantsSection (still stacking N editors, unchanged call-site shape) computes and passes each variant's sibling-tag suggestions. Additive only — no change to the stacked-card layout, existing rebuild/sample/move/delete behavior untouched and covered by the existing test suite (still green).

files.change: Added performance_tags?: string[] to the SpeakerProfile interface (backend surfaces this via task 004; frontend type previously lacked it).

Added optional tagSuggestions prop (sibling variants' tags, aggregated by the caller). Added handleSaveTags(), which POSTs { performance_tags } to /api/speaker-profiles/{name}/settings (the existing generic settings-write endpoint) then calls onRefresh(). Renders TagAutocompleteInput below the header's controls row, seeded with profile.performance_tags and suggestions = dedup(tagSuggestions + a small starter vocabulary: happy/sad/angry/calm/slow/fast/measured).

Threads a new tagSuggestions prop to each VariantEditor: dedup(other profiles' performance_tags), computed per-profile from the existing profiles array already in scope. No change to the stacked-card map/render shape (task 009 changes that call site).

Extended with a performance_tags describe block: renders existing tags as pills; adding a tag calls the settings-write endpoint with the updated array then onRefresh; removing a tag (via pill remove button) does the same with the shorter array; suggestions dropdown includes sibling-variant tags plus starter vocabulary. Pre-existing display-name test unchanged and still passes.
